reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Dispute ticket volume doubled since August (610→1260/month, E-05) while CRM response times remain within SLA (E-04), and the majority of disputed bills (1785 of 3025, E-02) attach to bills built from successfully recorded ACTUAL meter reads, not estimate substitution. Since no tariff change occurred during the period (E-03), the best-supported mechanism is a billing computation or import-validation defect in the billing-import step producing incorrect bills for ACTUAL-read accounts, independent of field/AMI read-acquisition problems, driving the dominant share of the dispute surge.
